reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team. Ilse posted there on 14 October that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal date is 25 November, and nothing in the channel since then has changed it.

I checked that Marcus is a member of #north-team before reading it, and I answered only from that channel. The renewal date counts as account information, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with the North team. I didn't look for a contract or account file to confirm the date. Ilse's message doesn't give a year, so I didn't add one.
